concurrent = 10
check_interval = 30
[[runners]]
  limit = 10
  request_concurrency = 10
  [runners.kubernetes]
    namespace = "{{.Release.Namespace}}"
    image = "ubuntu:22.04"
    privileged = true

    # Resource limits and requests
    # Build container
    cpu_request = "250m"
    cpu_limit = "2"
    memory_request = "512Mi"
    memory_limit = "2Gi"

    # Service container (for services like docker:dind)
    service_cpu_request = "50m"
    service_cpu_limit = "500m"
    service_memory_request = "256Mi"
    service_memory_limit = "1Gi"

    # Helper container
    helper_cpu_request = "50m"
    helper_cpu_limit = "500m"
    helper_memory_request = "128Mi"
    helper_memory_limit = "512Mi"

    # Cache volumes for package managers
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.pvc]]
      name = "cache"
      mount_path = "/cache"
      read_only = false

    # Docker certs
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
      name = "docker-certs"
      mount_path = "/certs/client"
      medium = "Memory"

#!/bin/bash
# Update the concurrent setting in the final config after registration
if [ -f "/.gitlab-runner/config.toml" ]; then
  sed -i 's/^concurrent = 1$/concurrent = 10/' /.gitlab-runner/config.toml
  echo "Updated concurrent setting to 10 in /.gitlab-runner/config.toml"
fi
pour one out for cobblemon academy

for f in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor; do
  echo powersave > "$f"
done
for f in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/energy_performance_preference; do
  echo balance_power > "$f"
done
for f in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_min_freq; do
  echo 400000 > "$f"
done
sleep infinity
